natural_body: Price-sensitive SMBs: 40% off drove signup +31%, revenue +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale: The two declining metrics (onboarding completion -4%, activation -6%) point at the same funnel stage, and onboarding is upstream of activation, so fixing it plausibly addresses both with one slot. I intend simplify_onboarding, but the two memories that carry that decision (memory_86 on shortening onboarding, memory_31 on cutting signup fields) are exactly the ones stated in vague qualitative terms — 'improved', 'durable lift' — with no effect sizes, no holdout description, and no durability window; memory_31 is also the oldest record here (day 12) and predates the current competitive environment. Those are the two worth spending the archive pulls on, because if either turns out to be a small, short-window, or confounded result, the whole rationale for the week thins out. I deliberately did not spend a pull on memory_73: it is the only memory that already carries hard numbers, and those numbers (signup +31%, revenue +18%, retention -12%) are self-warning — promotional pricing buys volume by destroying retention, which is the opposite of sustainable qualified revenue, and matching the competitor on price would likely deepen that. Referral incentives (memory_57) target established customers and do not touch the failing stage. Enterprise sales-assist (memory_44) is a real strength but does not address the SMB self-serve leak. Downstream value risk I am flagging explicitly: memory_31's mechanism is removing required signup fields, and those fields are plausibly what routes high-intent prospects into the demo-request path that memory_44 says produces better pipeline quality. So a naive form-cut could raise activation counts while quietly degrading qualified revenue — the exact metric I am supposed to maximize. Guardrails therefore: randomized holdout, and success is not activation rate alone but activation plus retained enterprise-lead routing and 30/60-day retention. If verification shows memory_86 and memory_31 were thin, I would downgrade to a small guarded test of activation_messaging (memory_91) instead of proceeding at full scale. Confidence is moderate, not high, because the direction rests on two summaries I have not yet read in original form.
